documents.name: TT9 Inc. Excavation Contract - Pennella
documents.issuer: TT9 Inc. (owner); signed via Dropbox Sign
documents.summary: Subcontract with Pennella Excavating & Demolition for foundation excavation and backfill of two houses, driveway rough grading and a property line tree removal. It carries a 10% holdback and a five-step payment schedule.
documents.purpose: To fix scope, price, payment milestones, holdback, compliance and change-order rules for excavation and backfill at 25 and 27 Mandrake.
documents.limitations: The document is a contract only. It proves what was agreed, not that any work has started or been paid.
missingInformation: Pennella WSIB clearance certificate
Pennella CGL certificate naming TT9 Inc. as additional insured
Utility locate confirmation
Commencement or mobilization evidence
Pennella invoices and payment records
Scale tickets for tree removal
inconsistencies: Net payable HST in Payments 1, 2 and 4 is computed on the net-of-holdback amount (e.g. $23,760 + $3,088.80 HST = $26,848.80 on Payment 2). Payment 3 pays 100% of HST, and HST on the gross would be $3,432. The HST treatment is inconsistent across the schedule.
The owner signature block reads 'TT9 INC. (OWNER / CONTRACTOR)'.

The document is dated 29-Sep-2026, before the project's recorded start date of 2026-10-26 and before the builders' risk policies were issued (13-Oct-2026), although the contract requires insurance and WSIB before site entry.
risks: Without WSIB and insurance on file, a payment may be made against a non-compliant subcontractor.
The holdback release depends on a lien search, which is not yet evidenced.
The spoiled soil, rock and dewatering exclusions could produce change-order claims.
recommendedActions: Collect Pennella's WSIB clearance and CGL certificate
Clarify the HST treatment with Pennella before processing Payment 1, 2 or 4
Record each Pennella invoice and payment against the milestone schedule
Run a lien search on titles of 25 and 27 Mandrake before releasing holdback

openFindings.title: Builders' risk policy postal code differs from project record
openFindings.detail: Both SPG builders' risk endorsement packages show postal code L1S 2B9, while the project record shows L1S 2c7 for 25 & 27 Mandrake, Ajax. The endorsement period also begins 9-Oct-2026 while the file names and certificates show 1-Oct-2026 inception. Confirm the insured address and the policy inception date with Acera Insurance Services so the cover matches the property.

openFindings.title: Permit drawing sets not on file; 3D model has no source drawings
openFindings.detail: The 3D site model says it was built from the permit sets, but no design, engineering or permit documents are on the project, even though the Design & Permits milestones are marked complete. Upload the permit drawing sets and building permit so the model and milestones can be verified. The model also includes 4 Barnes Dr, which is not part of this project.

openFindings.title: HST treatment inconsistent in Pennella payment schedule
openFindings.detail: In contract 2026-0172-REVISED, net payable HST for Payments 1, 2 and 4 is calculated on the amount after holdback (e.g. Payment 2: $26,848.80), but Payment 3 states 100% of HST is paid. Clarify with Pennella before processing invoices.

openFindings.title: No Pennella WSIB clearance or CGL certificate on file
openFindings.detail: Excavation contract 2026-0172-REVISED requires Pennella to provide a current WSIB clearance before site entry and with each billing, and CGL of at least $2M naming TT9 Inc. as additional insured. Only TT9's own insurance is on file. Obtain both before approving payments.

openFindings.title: Builders' risk policy expires 1-Jun-2027, one day after target completion
openFindings.detail: Policy SPG1026124 (25 Mandrake) runs to 1-Jun-2027 while the project target date is 2027-05-31. Any delay would leave the site without builders' risk cover; arrange extension/renewal with Acera Insurance Services. Same applies to 27 Mandrake policy SPG1026121.
